title: Bass hit by a tree branch; bridge accident; the Yo-Yo Boys
summary: He tells of a bass player pulled off a truck by a tree, Frank Mills's bass wrecked on a Mississippi bridge, and the Yo-Yo Boys with Andrew Jefferson and Stagley.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters

blocks.x: Oh, we experienced one of the, was, we always experienced one of the, uh, advertising, uptown somewhere, I can't remember the street, you know, I can't remember what bass player it was, but we were just a plane. Because one time I used to travel, I was traveling with a band, and a bass player, well, that was Frank Mills then. A fella called J.C. I used to travel with, I forget his whole name. And the bass, you used to have to always keep the bass on the side, especially the one you wasn't going for.
